products.description: The Yoga Pro 27UD-10 is a 26.5-inch 4K (3840x2160) QD-OLED Penta Tandem monitor at 120Hz aimed at creators, with 99% DCI-P3, 96% Adobe RGB and factory calibration to average Delta E < 1 in sRGB and Adobe RGB. Lenovo lists a modular 4K webcam, four microphones, 4x 7W plus 2x 3W speakers with Dolby Atmos, HDMI 2.1, DisplayPort in/out, USB-C with DP Alt Mode, a USB hub with three USB-C and two USB-A ports, and a 3-year warranty.
products.keywords: yoga pro 27ud-10 4k oled creator monitor webcam adobe rgb qd-oled

specs.panelDetails: 0.03 ms, Delta E < 1 (sRGB / Adobe RGB), modular 4K webcam, 4 mics, Dolby Atmos speakers

products.name: Lenovo ThinkVision P34WD-40 34" WQHD Curved USB-C Docking Monitor
products.summary: 34-inch curved WQHD IPS docking monitor with 120Hz, USB-C 140W power delivery, 2.5GbE and KVM.
products.description: The ThinkVision P34WD-40 is a 34-inch 21:9 curved IPS monitor at 3440x1440 with a 24-120Hz refresh range, 98% DCI-P3 and factory calibration to Delta E < 2. Its USB-C input supports DisplayPort Alt Mode and up to 140W power delivery, alongside HDMI 2.1, DisplayPort in/out for daisy-chaining, 2.5GbE Ethernet, five USB-A and two USB-C downstream ports, KVM and 2x 3W speakers, with a 3-year warranty.
products.keywords: thinkvision p34wd-40 ultrawide usb-c docking monitor 140w kvm curved

products.name: Lenovo ThinkVision P24QD-40 24" QHD 120Hz USB-C Monitor
products.summary: 23.8-inch QHD IPS docking monitor with 120Hz, USB-C 140W power delivery, 2.5GbE and daisy-chain DP out.
products.description: The ThinkVision P24QD-40 is a 23.8-inch QHD (2560x1440) IPS monitor with a 48-120Hz range, 99% sRGB and factory calibration to Delta E < 2. It adds a USB-C input with DisplayPort Alt Mode and 140W power delivery, HDMI 2.1, DisplayPort in/out, 2.5GbE Ethernet, a four-port USB-A hub, eKVM and a lift/tilt/pivot/swivel stand, with a 3-year warranty.
